qe: What clinical term designates the pathological presence of glucose in urine, typically when blood levels exceed the renal threshold?
qh: मूत्र में ग्लूकोज (शर्करा) की उपस्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है, जो मधुमेह (Diabetes) का एक मुख्य लक्षण है?
e: Concept: Normal me glucose khoon me rehti hai aur kidney usko chhan kar peshab me jaane se pehle poori tarah wapas absorb kar leti hai; par jab blood sugar itni badh jaye ki kidney ke carriers 'bhar' jayein (renal threshold ~180 mg/dL - jaise uncontrolled diabetes me), to bacha hua glucose urine me nikal jata hai - ise Glycosuria kehte hain. Baaki teen urine ke doosre abnormal findings hain: Proteinuria (protein - kidney ki jhilli kharab), Ketonuria (ketone bodies - bhookha/diabetes), Hematuria (khoon - stone/infection). Exam point: 'Urine me sugar = Glycosuria (blood sugar >180 mg/dL)'.

qe: Which acid-fast aerobic rod-shaped bacterium is the causative pathogen of human Tuberculosis (TB)?
qh: तपेदिक (टीबी) रोग के लिए कौन सा जीवाणु जिम्मेदार होता है जो मुख्य रूप से फेफड़ों को संक्रमित करता है?
e: Concept: TB (Tuberculosis) ek aisi bimari hai jo Mycobacterium tuberculosis naam ke bacteria se hoti hai - iski khaas pehchaan ye hai ki ye 'acid-fast' hai (isse stain karne par tezab se rang nahi chhutata, isliye lab me ise 'acid-fast bacilli/AFB' dekhte hain) aur ye ek 'aerobic rod' (saanse wali dandi) hai, isliye ye phephde ke upar wale hisson me (jahan oxygen zyada hai) ghar banata hai. Baaki teen doosre rogon ke bacteria hain: Streptococcus pneumoniae (nimonia), Salmonella typhi (typhoid), Corynebacterium diphtheriae (gale ka parda). Exam point: 'TB = Mycobacterium tuberculosis (acid-fast bacilli); test = AFB/sputum + Mantoux'.

qe: The 'DOTS' international public health strategy implemented for tuberculosis control stands for:
qh: टीबी के पूर्ण उपचार और नियंत्रण के लिए विश्व स्तर पर अपनाई जाने वाली 'डॉट्स' (DOTS) रणनीति का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: Concept: TB ka ilaaj lamba hota hai (6-9 mahine) aur usme sabse badi problem hai ki mareez dawa beech me chhod deta hai - isse dawa ka asar nahi hota aur 'drug-resistant' TB ban jata hai. Isliye Bharat/Duniya me DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course) strategy apnayi gayi - jisme koi bhi health worker (ASHA/DOTS provider) khud dekh kar mareez ko dawa khilata hai (aur dawa muft milti hai), taaki ilaaj poora ho. Baaki teen full forms bilkul galat fade hain. Exam point: 'DOTS = Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course (TB ilaaj poora karane ki strategy; India me NTEP ke through)'.

qe: In premature infants, Infant Respiratory Distress Syndrome (IRDS) is primarily caused by a developmental deficiency of alveolar:
qh: समय से पहले जन्मे शिशुओं में फेफड़ों की वायु थैलियों (Alveoli) को पिचकने से रोकने वाले किस पदार्थ की कमी से श्वसन संकट (IRDS) होता है?
e: Concept: Naye janme bachche ke phephde (alveoli) me cells Surfactant naam ka ek padarth banate hain (mukhya lipid: dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine/lecithin), jo alveoli ke andar paani ki 'tension' ghata kar unhe khula (phoola) rakhta hai - warna alveoli chipak kar band ho jaate hain. Premature (samay se pehle paida) bachche me ye surfactant abhi ban chuka nahi hota, isliye alveoli baar-baar band hokar saans ki takleef (IRDS - Infant Respiratory Distress Syndrome) hoti hai; ilaaj me surfactant diya jata hai/steroid. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Parietal pleura, Hemoglobin F, Carbonic anhydrase. Exam point: 'IRDS (premature babies) = surfactant ki kami (alveoli band pad jate hain)'.

qe: What clinical sign describes the bluish-purple discoloration of the skin and mucous membranes caused by excessive deoxygenated hemoglobin?
qh: रक्त में ऑक्सीजन की अत्यधिक कमी के कारण त्वचा और होठों का नीला पड़ जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Hemoglobin oxygen ke saath jude (laal, oxyhaemoglobin) hone par khoon chamakdar laal hota hai; jab sharir me kaafi hissa hemoglobin deoxygenated (oxygen chhoota hua) ho jata hai, to chamdi aur shleshmak patiyon (hoth, zubaan, naakhun) par neela-baigani (bluish-purple) rang dikhne lagta hai - ise Cyanosis kehte hain; ye phephda/heart ki bimari ya saans rukne ka emergency signal hai. Baaki teen alag chamdi ke rang hain: Erythema (laalpan - sujan/garmi se), Pallor (safedi - khoon ki kami), Jaundice (peelia - bilirubin). Exam point: 'Blue-purple chamdi = Cyanosis (deoxygenated haemoglobin ka badhna)'.

qe: What pathological condition results from an abnormal accumulation of excessive Carbon Dioxide (CO2) in arterial blood?
qh: धमनी रक्त में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (CO2) का स्तर सामान्य से बहुत अधिक बढ़ जाने की स्थिति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Respiration do taraf chalti hai - Oxygen andar jati hai aur CO2 bahar nikalni chahiye. Agar saans theek se na ho (jaise COPD, saans ki nali ki bimari, ya shallow breathing) to CO2 sharir me jama ho jata hai, aur uski maatra blood me badh jati hai - ise Hypercapnia kehte hain; isse sir dard, neend, confusion aur aage chal kar coma ho sakta hai (CO2 ek 'nasha' karne wala gas hai). Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Hypoxia (oxygen ki kami), Hypocapnia (CO2 badhta nahi - kam ho jaye), Asphyxia (oxygen poori tarah band + CO2 ka jama). Exam point: 'CO2 blood me zyada = Hypercapnia'; 'O2 kam = Hypoxia'.

qe: The expectoration or coughing up of blood originating from the bronchi, larynx, or lungs is medically diagnosed as:
qh: खांसी के साथ फेफड़ों या श्वास नली से खून आने (Coughing blood) को चिकित्सीय भाषा में क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Khansi ke saath khoon aana (khansi me khoon) - ye larynx, bronchi ya phephde se aata hai (chamakdar laal, jhaag bhara) - ise Hemoptysis kehte hain; iska sabse bada kaaran TB hai (Bharat me), aur phephde ka cancer, bronchiectasis, ya embolism bhi ho sakta hai. Baaki teen alag bleeding ke naam hain: Hematemesis (ulti me khoon - pet/aant se, kaala-bhura), Hematuria (peshab me khoon), Epistaxis (naak se khoon). Exam point: 'Khansi ke saath phephde se khoon = Hemoptysis (TB ka bada lakshan)'.

qe: The anatomical bifurcation ridge where the trachea divides into the right and left primary bronchi is the:
qh: श्वास नली (Trachea) पांचवीं वक्ष कशेरुका (T5) के स्तर पर दाएँ और बाएँ प्राथमिक ब्रोंकाई में किस बिंदु पर विभाजित होती है?
e: Concept: Trachea (saans ki nali) neeche jaakar do hisson me bat jati hai - right aur left primary bronchus; jis khaas ubhri hui kinare (ridge) par ye batwara hota hai, use Carina of Trachea kehte hain. Ye ek bahut hi sensitives hissa hai (ispar bronchoscopy ke waqt khaansi ka reflex hota hai), aur yahin par koi bahari cheez (coin, mungfali) atak sakti hai. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Glottis (khiya ka khula hissa), Epiglottis (khana rokne wala flap), Hyoid notch (gale ki haddi ka hissa). Exam point: 'Trachea ke do bronchi me batne wali ridge = Carina of trachea'.

qe: Which cyclical, abnormal breathing pattern features alternating periods of crescendo-decrescendo hyperpnea followed by central apnea?
qh: गंभीर हृदय विफलता या कोमा में सांस की गति का धीरे-धीरे बढ़ना, घटना और फिर कुछ समय के लिए रुक जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Cheyne-Stokes respiration ek ajeeb sa saans ka pattern hai: saans dheere-dheere tez (crescendo) hoti hai, phir kam (decrescendo) hokar poori ruk jati hai (apnea), phir wahi cycle - ye brain ke saans control center (diencephalon) ke kamzor padne ki nishani hai (heart failure, brain injury, stroke, aur gehri neend me bhi ho sakta hai). Baaki teen alag patterns hain: Biot's breathing (regular-apnea-regular), Eupnea (normal saans), Kussmaul breathing (deep fast - diabetes acidosis me). Exam point: 'Crescendo-decrescendo + apnea wala pattern = Cheyne-Stokes respiration'.

qe: Which inert gas is mixed with oxygen in the Heliox breathing gas cylinders of deep-sea saturation divers to prevent nitrogen narcosis?
qh: गहरे समुद्र में गोताखोरों को 'नाइट्रोजन नार्कोसिस' और विषाक्तता से बचाने के लिए ऑक्सीजन के साथ कौन सी अक्रिय गैस मिलाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Deep-sea (gehre samundar) me diver zyada pressure par nitrogen gas saans leta hai, jo uske khoon me ghul kar 'nitrogen narcosis' (nasha jaisa) kar deta hai; isse bachne ke liye diver ke cylinder me oxygen ke saath ek halka, inert gas mix karte hain - Helium - aur is mixture ko Heliox kehte hain (Helium halka hone se saans lena aasan aur nuksaan kam hota hai, aur ye 'inert' hai isliye sharir se nahi milta). Baaki teen gases iske liye galat hain: CO2 zehreela jama karta hai, Argon bhari inert gas hai, Hydrogen me aag ka khatra hai. Exam point: 'Gehre paani ke divers ka gas mix = Heliox (Helium + Oxygen); kaaran nitrogen narcosis se bachna'.

qe: The microscopic, thin-walled, polyhedral vascular air sacs representing the primary functional site of respiratory gas exchange are:
qh: फेफड़ों की वह मुख्य कार्यात्मक इकाई क्या है जहाँ रक्त और वायु के बीच ऑक्सीजन तथा CO2 का वास्तविक विनिमय होता है?
e: Concept: Phephde ke andar chhoti tiny thailiyan (microscopic, patli deewar wali) hote hain jahan hawa ki oxygen blood me jaati hai aur CO2 bahar aati hai - isi asli jagah ko Alveoli kehte hain; inka total surface area lagbhag ek tennis court jitna bada hota hai (600-700 sq ft), jisse gas exchange itni aasani se hota hai. Baaki teen diffs hain: Bronchioles hawa ki chhoti naliyan (exchange nahi), Pleural cavities thane, Tracheal rings nali ka sahara. Exam point: 'Gas exchange ka asli site = Alveoli (tennis court jitna total surface area)'.

qe: A localized or systemic deficiency in the delivery or utilization of oxygen at the tissue cellular level is termed:
qh: ऊतक स्तर पर कोशिकाओं को पर्याप्त ऑक्सीजन न मिल पाने की शारीरिक स्थिति क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Sharir ke tissue ke cell tak oxygen ka pahunchna ya use karna kam ho jana - ise Hypoxia kehte hain; ye chaar tarah ka ho sakta hai: oxygen kam (hypoxic), blood kam (anaemic), pump kam (stagnant/circulatory), aur cell ka poison (histotoxic - jaise cyanide). Iske lakshan hain: kam kaam me saans phoolna, confusion, hoth neele. Baaki teen alag concepts hain: Hypercapnia (CO2 zyada), Hyperoxia (oxygen zyada - harmful bhi), Ischemia (khoon aana band ho jana - sirf ek khaas jagah). Exam point: 'O2 ki kami = Hypoxia'; 'Blood flow rukna = Ischemia'.

qe: Insects execute direct respiration by distributing oxygen directly to internal organs through a complex chitinous network of:
qh: तिलचट्टे जैसे कीटों में रक्त के बिना सीधे ऊतकों तक ऑक्सीजन पहुँचाने वाली श्वसन नलिकाओं का जाल क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Insects ka koi phephda nahi hota - unme saans lene ka system 'tracheal system' hai: sharir ke bahar chhote chhed (spiracles) hote hain, jinse chitin ki patli naliyan (tracheal tubes) poori body me phaili hoti hain aur seedha har cell tak oxygen pahunchati hain (isliye unka khoon oxygen dhaane ka kaam nahi karta). Baaki teen doosre tarah ke breathing hain: Book lungs (spiders), Branchial gills (machhli), aur Malpighian sinuses (excretion se juda, saans nahi). Exam point: 'Insects ki saans = Tracheal tubes (spiracles se seedha cell tak oxygen)'.

qe: Adult amphibians like frogs survive burrowed underground during prolonged winter hibernation (aestivation) by respiring through:
qh: मेंढक मिट्टी के नीचे शीत निष्क्रियता (Hibernation) के दौरान किस अंग के माध्यम से श्वसन करते हैं?
e: Concept: Mendhak (frog) ki chamdi patli, num aur poori tarah blood vessels se bhari hoti hai - isliye jab wo paani me ya mitti me lambe samay tak (hibernation/aestivation) rehta hai, wo apni chamdi se hi saans le leta hai (cutaneous respiration - chamdi wali saans); ye uski saans ka ek bada hissa hai (aur iske alawa woh seeta-phusaphal se bhi saans leta hai). Baaki teen frog ke lagu nahi hain: Buccopharyngeal cavity saans ka ek hissa hai par mitti me wahi mukhya nahi, internal branchial gills tadpole me hote hain, Pulmonary lungs mitti me theek se kaam nahi karte. Exam point: 'Frog ki mitti/paani wali saans = Cutaneous respiration (chamdi se)'.

qe: The C-shaped incomplete cartilaginous rings encircling the anterior and lateral walls of the trachea are composed of:
qh: श्वास नली (Trachea) को पिचकने से रोकने वाले 'C-आकार' के छल्ले किस कार्टिलेज के बने होते हैं?
e: Concept: Trachea (saans ki nali) hamesha khuli nahi reh sakti agar wo poori tarah chamdi/jaani hoti; isliye uski deewar me 'C-shaped' (sikke jaisi adhoori) rings hoti hain - ye Hyaline Cartilage se banti hain (khaas kar ismein collagen fibrils hote hain), jo nali ko dhachan deti hain taaki hawa ka raasta khula rahe; peeche wala khula hissa isliye hota hai ki nigalte waqt khaana aage dhakka khaye (nali khinch sake). Baaki teen cartilages doosri jagah hain: Calcified matrix (haddi me), Fibrocartilage (disc me), Elastic cartilage (kaan ki topi). Exam point: 'Trachea ki C-rings = Hyaline cartilage (na ki haddi)'.

qe: Why is the left human lung anatomically smaller, possessing only two lobes compared to the right lung's three lobes?
qh: बायां फेफड़ा दाएं फेफड़े की तुलना में थोड़ा छोटा और केवल दो लोब वाला क्यों होता है?
o: To provide space for the liver
To accommodate the Cardiac Notch and leftward tilt of the human Heart
e: Concept: Seene (thorax) me do phephde hote hain par unke beech me dil thoda bayen taraf jhuka hua hota hai - is wajah se baye phephde ki jagah kam bachti hai: left lung me sirf 2 lobes hote hain aur usme ek khaas 'cardiac notch' banti hai jisme dil baithta hai; daayen phephde me bade hone ke kaaran 3 lobes hote hain (aur yahan foreign body zyada atakti hai kyunki right bronchus seedha/chauda hai). Baaki teen ye kaaran nahi hain: liver peechhe-neeche hota hai, aorta daayen taraf nahi, aur diaphragm neeche hai. Exam point: 'Left lung = 2 lobes (dil ke liye jagah), Right lung = 3 lobes'.

qe: High-Resolution Computed Tomography (HRCT) score assesses pulmonary parenchymal involvement across the lungs out of a maximum score of:
qh: कोविड या फेफड़ों के संक्रमण में किए जाने वाले एचआरसीटी (HRCT) स्कैन में फेफड़ों के 5 लोबों का अधिकतम स्कोर कितना होता है?
e: Concept: HRCT (High-Resolution CT) phephde ke andar ki bareek vishesh (parenchymal) photos deta hai aur ILD/TB jaisi bimariyon me uske kitne hisse affect hue hain, ise score karte hain: har lung ke paas 5 lobes/bhaag maan kar har ek ko 0 se 5 ke score me baantaa jaata hai (0 = normal, 5 = worst) - dono taraf milkar maximum 25 ka score banta hai (ye aajkal COVID/ILD me famous hua tha - 'CT score 25 me se X'). Baaki teen numbers (10, 50, 100) is scoring ka max nahi hain. Exam point: 'HRCT score ka maximum = 25 (5 lobes x 5 points)'.

qe: The vocal organ of birds responsible for producing complex birdsong, located at the base of the trachea, is the:
qh: पक्षियों में श्वास नली के विभाजन पर स्थित मधुर ध्वनि उत्पन्न करने वाला विशिष्ट अंग क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Pakshiyon me awaaz (birdsong) ek khaas organ se nikalta hai jo trachea ke aakhir/base par hota hai - Syrinx (isliye ise 'birds ka larynx' bhi kehte hain). Isme khaas jhilli (membrane) hoti hai jise wo control karke tarah-tarah ki awaaz (bamboo se bansi jaisa) nikalte hain - insaan ka awaaz ka organ larynx hai, par birds me syrinx hi hai. Baaki teen insaan ke organs hain: Epiglottis (khana rokne wala flap), Pharynx (gala), Larynx (voice box). Exam point: 'Pakshiyon ki awaaz ka organ = Syrinx (trachea ke base par)'.

qe: The prominent anterior laryngeal protrusion of the thyroid cartilage, noticeably enlarged in post-pubertal males, is the:
qh: पुरुषों के गले में स्वरयंत्र (Larynx) की थायराइड कार्टिलेज का बाहर निकला हुआ उभार क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Larynx (khiya) ke aage ek khaas ubhri hui haddi ki dhap hoti hai - thyroid cartilage - jo purushon me buloogat ke baad (testosterone ke asar se) moti ho jati hai aur gale me 'Adam's Apple' ki tarah saaf dikhti hai; isi wajah se ladkon ki aawaz bhari ho jati hai. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Cricoid notch, Hyoid process (ye ek haddi hai jo larynx ke upar hoti hai), aur Carina (trachea ka batwara). Exam point: "'Adam's Apple' = Thyroid cartilage (larynx ka bada ubhaar, purushon me zyada)".

qe: In terrestrial vertebrates, what primary muscle forms the dome-shaped floor of the thoracic cavity to drive inspiration?
qh: वक्ष गुहा के फर्श पर स्थित वह गुंबद के आकार की मुख्य मांसपेशी कौन सी है जो सांस लेने और छोड़ने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Concept: Saans lena ek mechanical kaam hai: seene ki chhat wali jaga (thoracic cavity) ko chauda karna padta hai - ye kaam ek chhata (dome) jaisi muscle Diaphragm karti hai, jo seene ke neeche peeth (abdomen) ko choda karti hai: jab wo sikudti hai (neeche hoti hai) to seene ke andar jagah badhti hai aur hawa andar kheench li jati hai. Isliye aaram se saans lene ka mukhya muscle Diaphragm hai. Baaki teen alag muscles hain: Internal intercostals (exhalation me madad), Rectus abdominis (pet ki muscle), Scalene (kandha). Exam point: 'Saans lene (inspiration) ka mukhya muscle = Diaphragm'.

qe: What involuntary neuro-muscular spasm involving the phrenic nerve and diaphragm with sudden glottic closure causes 'Hiccups' (Singultus)?
qh: 'हिचकी' (Hiccups) आने का मुख्य शारीरिक कारण क्या होता है?
o: Involuntary spasmodic contraction of the Diaphragm followed by abrupt vocal cord closure
e: Concept: Hiccups tab hote hain jab phrenic nerve ke signal se Diaphragm achaanak bina marzi ke sikudta hai (spasm), aur usi waqt vocal cords (awaaz ki rassein) turant band ho jati hain - isi akadan se wo 'hik' ki awaaz nikalti hai; khaana jaldi khaana, bahut khaana, jalana/sharab, ya nerve me jalna iska kaaran ban sakta hai. Baaki teen iske kaaran nahi hain: surfactant ki kami (IRDS), sirf acid reflux, aur alveoli ka achaanak chipakna. Exam point: 'Hiccups = Diaphragm ka achaanak spasm + vocal cords ka band hona (phrenic nerve se)'.

qe: What volumetric parameter defines the amount of air inspired or expired during a single normal, unforced breathing cycle at rest?
qh: विश्राम अवस्था में एक सामान्य सांस में ली जाने वाली या छोड़ी जाने वाली हवा की मात्रा (Tidal Volume) लगभग कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Saans lene ki volume ko napne ke liye khaas shabd hote hain; jab insaan aaram se (sahaj, bina koshish) ek saans me andar-bahar hawa leta hai, us hawa ki matra lagbhag 500 ml hoti hai - ise Tidal Volume kehte hain (tide ki tarah aana-jaana). Baaki teen alag volumes hain: ~3500 ml Inspiratory Reserve Volume, ~1200-1500 ml Expiratory Reserve, aur ~150 ml dead space. Exam point: 'Normal/restful ek saans = 500 ml (Tidal Volume)'.

qe: The volume of air remaining inside the pulmonary alveoli even after the most forceful, maximal exhalation is the:
qh: पूरी ताकत लगाकर सांस बाहर निकालने के बाद भी फेफड़ों में बची रहने वाली हवा की मात्रा क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Phephde ko poori tarah khaali nahi kiya ja sakta - chahe insaan poori taakat se saans bahar chhode, phir bhi alveoli aur naliyon me lagbhag 1100-1200 ml hawa bachi reh jati hai; ise Residual Volume (bacha hua volume) kehte hain. Ye zaroori hai kyunki isi wajah se alveoli chipak kar band nahi hote aur gas exchange kabhi poori tarah nahi rukti. Baaki teen alag volumetric shabd hain: Expiratory reserve volume, Vital capacity (poori nikali jane wali hawa), Tidal volume. Exam point: 'Sabse zyada nikalne ke baad bacha hua volume = Residual Volume (~1100-1200 ml)'.

qe: Vital Capacity (VC), representing the maximum volume of air a person can breathe out after a maximal inhalation, equals:
qh: फेफड़ों की 'जैव क्षमता' (Vital Capacity) किन तीन श्वसन आयतनों का योग होती है?
e: Concept: Vital Capacity (VC) matlab insaan sabse gehri saans lene ke baad, poori taakat se jitni hawa bahar nikaal sakta hai - isme teen hisse judte hain: Tidal Volume (500) + Inspiratory Reserve Volume (~3000) + Expiratory Reserve Volume (~1200) = kul lagbhag 4000-4500 ml. Ise spirometer se naapa jata hai aur asma/COPD me ye kam ho jati hai. Baaki teen formulas galat hain: FRC + RV, TLC - TV, aur TV + RV (ye Residual + Tidal ko jod deta hai jo khaali nahi hota). Exam point: 'Vital Capacity = TV + IRV + ERV (~4-4.5 litre)'.

qe: Carbon dioxide generated in peripheral tissues is predominantly transported back to pulmonary capillaries as:
qh: ऊतकों से फेफड़ों तक कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (CO2) का लगभग 70% परिवहन रक्त में किस रूप में होता है?
o: Dissolved molecular CO2 gas in plasma (7%)
e: Concept: Tissue me bana CO2 khoon me teen tarah se travel karta hai: (1) lagbhag 70% ek rasayanik roop me - RBC ke andar carbonic anhydrase enzyme CO2 ko paani ke saath mila kar Bicarbonate (HCO3-) banata hai, jo plasma me chala jata hai (2) 20-25% haemoglobin ke protein hisse (globin) se chipka (carbamino-haemoglobin), aur (3) sirf 7% seedha ghula hua CO2. Isliye lung tak CO2 pahunchane ka mukhya roop Bicarbonate hai. Baaki teen chhote hisse/dhoka hain: 'solid carbonic crystals' to physics-fiction hai. Exam point: 'CO2 ka mukhya transport (~70%) = Plasma bicarbonate (HCO3-)'.

qe: Which zinc metalloenzyme within erythrocytes accelerates the interconversion of carbon dioxide and water into carbonic acid?
qh: लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं (RBC) में CO2 को कार्बोनिक एसिड और बाइकार्बोनेट में बदलने की क्रिया को तेज करने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: CO2 ko khoon me le jaane ke liye RBC me ek zinc-wala enzyme hota hai - Carbonic Anhydrase - jo CO2 + paani ko jaldi jaldi Carbonic acid (H2CO3) me badalta hai (aur ye aage bicarbonate aur H+ me toot jata hai); yahi enzyme CO2 ko crores guna tez process me badalne me madad karta hai. Isi tarah isse kidney me acid-base balance ke liye bhi use hota hai (dawa - acetazolamide isi ko rokta hai). Baaki teen enzymes alag kaam karte hain: Lactate dehydrogenase (anaerobic), Amylase (starch), Cytochrome c oxidase (respiration chain, cyanide ka target). Exam point: 'CO2 <-> bicarbonation ka enzyme = Carbonic anhydrase (RBC ke andar)'.

qe: The 'Chloride Shift' (Hamburger Phenomenon) maintains electrical neutrality across the erythrocyte membrane by exchanging:
qh: हैम्बर्गर घटना या 'क्लोराइड शिफ्ट' में विद्युत तटस्थता बनाए रखने के लिए RBC में क्या अंदर और क्या बाहर जाता है?
o: Chloride ions (Cl-) entering RBCs as Bicarbonate ions (HCO3-) diffuse out into plasma
e: Concept: Jab RBC ke andar CO2 se bicarbonate (HCO3-) banta hai, to HCO3- bahar (plasma) nikalta hai - par uske saath chloride (Cl-) RBC ke andar aa jata hai taaki electric charge (<- aur +) barabar rahe; isi chloride ka andar-bahar aane-jaane ko Chloride Shift (Hamburger phenomenon) kehte hain. Isse poori rasayanik chain bina rukawat chalti hai. Baaki teen jodiyan galat hain (Ca-Mg, proton-hydrogen, Na-K) inme se koi blood CO2 transport me nahi hoti. Exam point: 'Chloride shift = Cl- andar aur HCO3- bahar (charge balance ke liye)'.

qe: The 'Bohr Effect' describes how an increase in pCO2 and a decrease in blood pH shifts the oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve to the:
qh: 'बोहर प्रभाव' (Bohr Effect) के अनुसार अम्लीय माध्यम और उच्च CO2 होने पर हीमोग्लोबिन ऑक्सीजन वियोजन वक्र किस दिशा में खिसकता है?
o: Right (facilitating O2 unloading at active tissues)
e: Concept: Bohr Effect kehta hai ki jab khoon me CO2 aur acidity (H+ kam pH) badh jaye - jo mehnet karne wale tissue me hota hai - to haemoglobin ki oxygen se pakad kamzor ho jati hai aur wo O2 chhod deta hai (curve daayen/right taraf shift ho jata hai). Isse jahan zaroorat hai wahan oxygen pahunch jati hai; phir lung me (jahan CO2 kam ho jata hai) O2 dobara bandh li jati hai. Baaki teen curves galat hain: left shift iska ulta (oxygen pakad badhna), straight vertical/hyperbolic iska shape nahi hai. Exam point: 'Bohr effect = CO2/H+ badhne par O2 chhodna (curve right shift)'.

qe: The 'Haldane Effect' establishes that deoxygenation of blood in systemic tissues increases hemoglobin's capacity to:
qh: 'हल्डेन प्रभाव' (Haldane Effect) के अनुसार जब हीमोग्लोबिन से ऑक्सीजन अलग होती है, तो उसकी क्या ले जाने की क्षमता बढ़ जाती है?
e: Concept: Haldane Effect Bohr effect ka doosra pehlu hai: jab khoon oxygen chhodta hai (tissue me deoxygenated ho jata hai) to us haemoglobin ki CO2 bandhne ki kshamta badh jati hai - isi wajah se tissue se CO2 aasani se khoon me aata hai; ulta lung me jab oxygen milti hai to CO2 chhod di jati hai (aur bahar nikal jati hai). Ye do effects milkar O2 aur CO2 dono ko sahi jagah pahunchane me madad karte hain. Baaki teen kaam is hormone/mechanism ka hai hi nahi (platelets aggregate, nitrogen, glucose). Exam point: 'Haldane = deoxygenation se CO2 bandhne ki kshamta badhna'.

qe: Chronic alveolar septal wall breakdown with loss of elastic recoil and irreversible pulmonary air trapping is:
qh: धूम्रपान के कारण फेफड़ों की एल्वियोली की दीवारों का फट जाना और सांस फूलना किस बीमारी (Emphysema) का लक्षण है?
e: Concept: Emphysema me saalon tak dhuaan/tamaku ke kaaran phephde ki alveoli ki patli deewar (septal wall) toot jaati hai aur wo badi hawa ki thailiyan ban jati hain - is wajah se: (1) elastic recoil kam ho jata hai (phephda wapas sikud nahi paata), (2) hawa andar phansi reh jati hai (air trapping) aur (3) gas exchange ka area kam ho jata hai; ye 'irreversible' (wapas na hone wala) hai, isliye COPD ka hissa hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Asthma (reversible blockage), Bronchiectasis (naliyan failna), Pneumothorax (seene me hawa). Exam point: 'Alveolar wall ka tutna + elastic recoil kam = Emphysema (COPD, smoking se)'.

qe: The neuro-anatomical 'Pneumotaxic Center' that regulates the inspiratory 'switch-off' point to modulate respiratory rate is located in the:
qh: सांस लेने की अवधि को सीमित करने और दर नियंत्रित करने वाला 'न्यूमोटेक्सिक केंद्र' मस्तिष्क के किस भाग में स्थित होता है?
e: Concept: Saans ka pattern brain ke do center chalate hain: medulla ka respiratory center basic rhythm banata hai, aur Pons (Varolii) me ek 'Pneumotaxic Center' hota hai jo inspiratory (saans lene) ke 'switch-off' point ko control karta hai - matlab ye tay karta hai ki saans kitni lambi leni hai aur kitni tezi se (rate) chalti rahegi. Baaki teen doosre hisse hain: Cerebral cortex (marzi se saans lena), Cerebellum (movement coordination), Medulla (basic rhythm). Exam point: 'Saans ki rate/switch-off = Pneumotaxic center (Pons me)'.

qe: The anatomic 'Dead Space' volume in a healthy human adult's conducting airway averages approximately:
qh: मानव श्वास नली और ब्रोंकाई में मौजूद उस हवा की मात्रा को क्या कहते हैं जो गैस विनिमय में भाग नहीं लेती (Dead Space Volume)?
e: Concept: Dead space wo hawa hai jo gas exchange me hissa nahi leti - kyunki ye nali (trachea, bronchi) me hi bhari rehti hai; ek sehatmand adult me ye lagbhag 150 ml hoti hai (aur har saans ke 500 ml me se sirf ~350 ml alveoli tak pahunchti hai). Isi wajah se unche saans lene se (deep breathing) gas exchange zyada asardar hota hai. Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 1000, 500 (tidal volume) aur 50. Exam point: 'Anatomical dead space = ~150 ml (conducting airways ki hawa)'.

qe: Why does the standard Oxygen-Hemoglobin Dissociation Curve exhibit a characteristic Sigmoid (S-shaped) profile?
qh: ऑक्सीजन-हीमोग्लोबिन वियोजन वक्र का आकार 'सिग्मॉइड' (S-आकार) क्यों होता है?
o: Cooperative Binding: Binding of the first O2 molecule alters quaternary structure to enhance affinity for subsequent O2 molecules
e: Concept: Oxygen-Haemoglobin dissociation curve 'S' (sigmoid) shape ki kyun hoti hai? Kyunki haemoglobin me 4 subunits hote hain aur wo 'cooperative binding' karte hain: pehla O2 molecule judte hi Hb ka aakar badal jata hai aur baki subunits ki O2 se mohabbat (affinity) badh jati hai, isliye doosra, teesra, chautha O2 tezi se jud jate hain - isse curve ka beech ka khamma tez chadhta hai (S-shape). Isi wajah se lung me O2 aasani se bandhti hai aur tissue me aasani se chhut jati hai. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain: passive diffusion ka linear curve hota hai, temperature fluctuation iska shape nahi, heme ka tootna rog hai. Exam point: 'Sigmoid curve = Cooperative binding (4 O2 ke subunits ka saath judna)'.

qe: Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) and high-altitude pulmonary edema are directly precipitated by:
qh: पहाड़ों पर अधिक ऊंचाई पर जाने पर सिरदर्द और उल्टी (माउंटेन सिकनेस) का प्राथमिक कारण क्या होता है?
o: A decrease in atmospheric barometric pressure lowering the partial pressure of oxygen (pO2)
A drop in the atmospheric percentage of oxygen below 21%
e: Concept: Unche pahaad par (jaise Leh, Everest area) 'atmospheric barometric pressure' kam ho jata hai - isliye hawa me oxygen ka percentage (21%) wahi rehta hai par uska partial pressure (pO2) kam ho jata hai; isse khoon me oxygen kam pahunchti hai (hypobaric hypoxia) aur Acute Mountain Sickness (sir dard, ulti, chakkar) aur kabhi phephde me paani (HAPE) ya brain me sojan (HACE) aa jata hai. Isi wajah se unche pahaad par kadam-dar-kadam chadhna (acclimatization) zaroori hai. Baaki teen galat hain: CO2 ka badhna, nitrogen, aur oxygen ka % 21 se neeche girna (aisa nahi hota). Exam point: 'High-altitude sickness = barometric pressure/pO2 ka girna (oxygen % nahi girta)'.

qe: The protective Hering-Breuer Inflation Reflex prevents pulmonary over-distension via stretch receptor signaling carried by which nerve?
qh: फेफड़ों को जरूरत से ज्यादा फूलने और फटने से बचाने वाला हेरिंग-ब्रूअर रिफ्लेक्स किस तंत्रिका द्वारा संचालित होता है?
e: Concept: Phephde ke andar khaas 'stretch receptors' hote hain - jab phephda bahut zyada phool jaye (over-distension), to ye receptors Vagus nerve (10th cranial nerve) ke through brain ko signal bhejte hain ki 'bas, ab saans rok lo'; isse saans lena ruk jata hai aur phephda zyada nahi phoolta - ise Hering-Breuer Inflation Reflex kehte hain. Baaki teen nerves/structures ye reflex nahi karte: Sympathetic chain (BP/emergency), Trigeminal (chehra), Phrenic (diaphragm ko hilana - reflex ka signal nahi). Exam point: 'Phephde ka over-inflation rokne wala reflex = Hering-Breuer reflex (vagus nerve se)'.

qe: Pulmonary fibrosis resulting from chronic occupational inhalation of crystalline silica dust particles is diagnosed as:
qh: पत्थर तोड़ने या खदानों में काम करने वाले मजदूरों के फेफड़ों में सिलिका की धूल जमने से होने वाली बीमारी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Kuch kaam wale saans ki bimariyan dust (dhool) se hoti hain; silica (kankad/baloo/stone dust) wale kam karne wale (khadaan, building, glass industry) saalon tak bareek crystalline silica particles saans ke through lete rehte hain - ye phephde me pahunch kar alveoli ki deewar par nishaan (fibrosis) banate hain aur saans ki kshamta kam karte hain; isi bimari ko Silicosis kehte hain ('stone mason's disease'). Baaki teen alag occupational diseases hain: Byssinosis (cotton dust), Asbestosis (asbestos), Emphysema (mostly smoking). Exam point: 'Silica dust se phephde ki fibrosis = Silicosis'.

qe: The universal first stage of cellular glucose catabolism occurring strictly in the cytoplasm independent of oxygen is:
qh: ऑक्सी और अनॉक्सी दोनों प्रकार के श्वसन का पहला समान चरण जो कोशिका द्रव्य में होता है:
e: Concept: Glycolysis (EMP pathway) glucose tootne ka pehla aur 'universal' step hai - ye cytoplasm me hota hai, isme oxygen ki zaroorat nahi (anaerobic bhi chal sakta hai) aur ye har cell me (aur ek purane prokaryote me bhi) same tarike se chalta hai; isme 1 glucose se 2 pyruvate bante hain. Baaki teen iske baad ke oxygen wale (mitochondrial) steps ya fermentation hain: Krebs cycle (matrix), Fermentation (ye glycolysis ke baad ka anaardra rasta hai), Oxidative phosphorylation (inner membrane). Exam point: 'Glucose ka pehla tootna (cytoplasm, O2 ki zaroorat nahi) = Glycolysis/EMP'.

qe: What is the net gain of energy molecules generated directly during Glycolysis from a single molecule of glucose?
qh: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस प्रक्रिया के दौरान एक ग्लूकोज अणु से शुद्ध (Net Gain) कितने एटीपी और एनएडीएच प्राप्त होते हैं?
e: Concept: Glycolysis me 1 glucose se 2 pyruvate bante hain, aur ek achhi tarah se ginte to: pehle 2 ATP lagti hain (investment), phir 4 ATP banti hain aur 2 NADH bhi banti hain - isliye 'net gain' = 2 ATP + 2 NADH + 2 pyruvate aata hai. Baaki teen options galat hain: 1 ATP/1 pyruvate (kam), 36 ATP + 2 FADH2 (ye poore respiration ka total - mitochondria ke saath), aur 4 ATP + 0 NADH (4 sirf gross ATP hai, net nahi). Exam point: 'Glycolysis ka net gain = 2 ATP + 2 NADH (per glucose)'.

qe: Where inside the eukaryotic cell do the enzymatic reactions of the Krebs Cycle (Citric Acid Cycle) take place?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिका में क्रैब्स चक्र (TCA चक्र) की एंजाइमी अभिक्रियाएं माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया के किस भाग में होती हैं?
e: Concept: Glycolysis ka pyruvate agar oxygen mile to mitochondria ke andar jaata hai, wahan Krebs Cycle (Citric acid cycle/TCA) chalta hai. Ye cycle mitochondrial matrix (mitochondria ke andar ka ghulne wala dravya) me hota hai - yahan acetyl-CoA se citric acid banti hai aur usse CO2 nikalta hai + NADH/FADH2 bante hain. Baaki teen jagah alag kaam ke liye hain: Inner membrane cristae (electron transport chain), Intermembrane space (H+ ka jama), aur Cytosol me sirf glycolysis. Exam point: 'Krebs cycle = Mitochondrial matrix (glycolysis = cytosol)'.

qe: Which molecule acts as the critical transition 'Connecting Link' between cytoplasmic Glycolysis and the mitochondrial Krebs Cycle?
qh: ग्लाइकोलाइसिस और क्रैब्स चक्र के बीच योजक कड़ी (Connecting Link) के रूप में कार्य करने वाला 2-कार्बन अणु कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Glycolysis ka 3-carbon pyruvate seedha Krebs cycle me nahi ghus sakta - pehle usko enzyme (pyruvate dehydrogenase, mitochondria ke andar) ke through badla jata hai ek 2-carbon padarth 'Acetyl-CoA' me, aur yahi acetyl-CoA phir cycle me chala jata hai (CO2 chhod kar). Isliye ise glycolysis aur Krebs ke beech ka 'connecting link' kehte hain (aur ye carbohydrate + fat + protein metabolism ka bhi junction hai). Baaki teen isi cycle ke doosre terms hain: Citric acid, Succinyl-CoA, Oxaloacetate. Exam point: 'Glycolysis <-> Krebs ka linking molecule = Acetyl-CoA'.

qe: The multi-protein Complex V (ATP Synthase / F0-F1 particles) responsible for generating ATP during oxidative phosphorylation is located on the:
qh: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया में प्रोटॉन प्रवणता से एटीपी (ATP) बनाने वाले ऑक्सीसोम (F0-F1 कण) कहाँ स्थित होते हैं?
e: Concept: Respiration ke aakhri stage (oxidative phosphorylation) me electron ka pura chain inner mitochondrial membrane ke cristae (folds) me lagta hai, aur isi membrane me Complex V - ATP Synthase (F0-F1 particles) - ka phool jaisa dhaancha hota hai. Ye H+ (protons) ko ek taraf se doosri taraf guzaar kar uski energy se ADP + Pi se ATP banata hai - yahi asli 'powerhouse' ka engine hai. Baaki teen jagah nahi hain: Nuclear envelope, Outer membrane, Matrix fluid (yahan Krebs hota hai). Exam point: 'ATP banane wali machine (Complex V/F0-F1) = Inner mitochondrial membrane par'.

qe: What is the theoretical Respiratory Quotient (RQ = CO2 eliminated / O2 consumed) during the complete oxidation of carbohydrates (glucose)?
qh: कार्बोहाइड्रेट (ग्लूकोज) के पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण के दौरान श्वसन गुणांक (RQ) का मान कितना होता है?
e: Concept: Respiratory Quotient (RQ) batata hai ki sharir konsa khaan jala raha hai - kyunki CO2 chhodne aur O2 lene ka anupat khaan ke hisaab se badalta hai. Glucose (carbohydrate) ke liye: C6H12O6 + 6O2 -> 6CO2 + 6H2O, yaani CO2/O2 = 6/6 = 1.0 - yahi RQ ka maximum/unity hai. Baaki teen values doosre tattvon ke liye hain: 0.7 (pure fat), 0.9 (protein/mix), Infinity (kabhi nahi - to bhi ye thermodynamic taur par galat hai). Exam point: 'Carbohydrate (glucose) ka RQ = 1.0; Fat = 0.7; mixed khane = 0.85 ke aas-paas'.

qe: What terminal biochemical event makes cellular respiration instantly lethal in acute Cyanide poisoning?
qh: साइनाइड (Cyanide) जहर खाने पर कुछ ही सेकंडों में मृत्यु किस एंजाइम के अवरुद्ध होने से होती है?
o: Irreversible inhibition of Cytochrome c Oxidase (Complex IV) of the Electron Transport Chain
e: Concept: Cyanide ek zeher hai jo Electron Transport Chain ke Complex IV - Cytochrome c Oxidase - par ja kar chipak jata hai aur use band (inhibit) kar deta hai. Isse cell oxygen ki maujoodgi me bhi ATP bana nahi paata (matlab cell 'saans nahi le paata') aur kuch minute me maut ho sakti hai - isliye ye instant-lethal poison hai (aur iska antidote/antidote kit hota hai). Baaki teen galat hain: haemoglobin ka ghalna, airvesicle ka phatna, nali band - ye kuch doosre zeher/conditions ka kaam hai. Exam point: 'Cyanide = ETC Complex IV (cytochrome oxidase) ka block = cell ki saans ruk jana'.

qe: The presence of atmospheric air inside the intrapleural cavity abolishing negative intrapleural pressure and collapsing the lung is a:
qh: छाती में चोट लगने से प्ल्यूरल गुहा में हवा भर जाने और फेफड़े के पिचक जाने (Collapse) की स्थिति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Phephde ki do patli jhilliyan hote hain: (1) bahar wali parietal pleura (seene ki deewar se chipki) aur (2) andar wali visceral pleura (phephde se chipki) - inke beech ki jaga (intrapleural cavity) me normal me thoda fluid hota hai aur wo 'negative pressure' (vacuum jaisa) rehta hai, yahi phephda kholkar rakhta hai. Agar chot/operation/bimari se wahan hawa aa jaye to pressure barabar ho jata hai aur phephda sikud (collapse) jata hai - ise Pneumothorax kehte hain (chest tube se hawa nikal kar ilaaj). Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Hemothorax (khoon), Atelectasis (alveoli chipakna), Hydrothorax (paani). Exam point: 'Pleural cavity me hawa = Pneumothorax (phephda collapse)'.

qe: The deep, rapid, labored hyperventilatory breathing pattern observed in severe Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) to blow off CO2 is:
qh: मधुमेह के रोगियों में एसिडोसिस को संतुलित करने के लिए होने वाली गहरी और तेज सांस (गैस्पिंग) क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Kussmaul breathing ek gehri, tez aur mehnat wali saans hai jo khaas kar severe Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA - diabetes ka emergency) me dekhi jati hai; iska kaaran ye hai ki Kussmaul sahab ne pehchan liya ki seene me CO2 badhne se blood tezabi (acidic) ho jata hai, aur body saans tez karke CO2 'uda' kar acid ko kam karti hai. Baaki teen alag patterns hain: Orthopnea (letne par dikkat), Biot's (irregular-apnea), Cheyne-Stokes (crescendo-decrescendo) - teeno brain/heart se jude hain. Exam point: 'Diabetic acidosis me gehri tez saans = Kussmaul breathing (CO2 udaane ke liye)'.

qe: Difficulty breathing or respiratory distress that exacerbates in a recumbent (flat lying) posture and improves upon sitting upright is:
qh: सीधे लेटने पर सांस लेने में भारी कठिनाई होना जो उठकर बैठने पर ठीक हो जाती है (Orthopnea), किस अंग की विफलता का संकेत है?
o: Orthopnea (often seen in Congestive Heart Failure)
e: Concept: Orthopnea wo halat hai jisme mareez ko letne (peeshe) par saans ki takleef badh jati hai, aur wo sitkar (khada/taakiyauns lagakar) hi aaram se saans le paata hai; ye khaas kar Congestive Heart Failure (dil ki kamzori) me dikh ta hai, kyunki letne par phephde me khoon/paani zyada bhar jata hai. Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Eupnea (normal saans), Dyspnea (saans ki takleef - sab sthiti me), Apnea (saans ka poori tarah rukna - jaise sleep apnea). Exam point: 'Letne par saans phoolna, baithne par aaram = Orthopnea (heart failure ka sign)'.

qe: What is the primary cellular function of the respiratory 'Mucociliary Escalator' lining the pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium of the trachea?
qh: श्वास नली (Trachea) की सिलियायुक्त उपकला कोशिकाओं का 'म्यूकोसिलियरी एस्केलेटर' फेफड़ों की रक्षा कैसे करता है?
o: Rhythmic upward beating of cilia propelling trapped particulate dust and pathogens toward the pharynx to be swallowed or expectorated
e: Concept: Trachea aur bronchi ki andar ki parat 'pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium' se banti hai - ismein do cheezein hoti hain: (1) shleshm (mucus) banane wali goblet cells jo dhool, bacteria aur keetnu ko chipka leti hain, aur (2) chhote baal (cilia) jo ek lehar (rhythm) me upar ki taraf chalte rehte hain. Isi ko 'Mucociliary Escalator' kehte hain - ye dhool/bacteria ko gale tak pahunchata hai, jahan se wo nigal liya jata hai ya khaanskar bahar nikal jata hai (smoking se ye system kharab hote hi khansi aur infection badh jate hain). Baaki teen kaam ye nahi karte: Oxygen diffusion (wo alveoli me), awaaz (larynx/syrinx), surfactant (alveoli ke type-2 cells). Exam point: 'Mucociliary escalator = cilia ka dhool/pathogens ko hila kar gale tak bhejna'.
